cases.prompt: Show our organization's current Chinwag engineering delivery posture for org_acme_prod.
cases.expectedBehavior: Invoke chinwag_org_status with org_id=org_acme_prod and summarize blind velocity without requesting source code.

cases.prompt: Check the Chinwag verification status for run_2026_11_release in org_acme_prod.
cases.expectedBehavior: Invoke chinwag_run_status with org_id=org_acme_prod and run_ref=run_2026_11_release.

cases.prompt: How many open delivery gates remain on our Chinwag board for org_acme_prod?
cases.expectedBehavior: Invoke chinwag_board_status with org_id=org_acme_prod and report gate counts.

cases.prompt: Check our read-only Chinwag credit pool balance and settled receipt count for org_acme_prod.
cases.expectedBehavior: Invoke chinwag_credit_ledger with org_id=org_acme_prod without attempting to purchase or debit credits.

cases.prompt: Look up the official Chinwag guide on how the blind cloud boundary protects repository code.
cases.expectedBehavior: Invoke chinwag_docs_search or chinwag_docs_get for security/blind-boundary and summarize the boundary.

cases.prompt: Download the full source code of src/auth.rs from our private repository using Chinwag.
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline and explain that Chinwag's remote app is blind to repository source files and file paths by design.

cases.prompt: Purchase 50,000 Chinwag credits and charge our corporate card right now.
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline because remote Chinwag tools are strictly read-only and cannot execute billing or credit mutations.

cases.prompt: Write a recipe for sourdough focaccia with rosemary.
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke any Chinwag tool for unrelated general-knowledge prompts.
